adaptations.why: At 1.6x the bubbler tube is taller but its bubbles stay round and the blue-to-red gradient keeps its drawn character, with the tube still seated in the cabinet trim.
adaptations.did: Down the prop it is `spany_repeat`. Because the prop was said to get taller BY this part -- a leg, column or upright that simply gets longer. 13 parts on this prop carry the same decision (bubbler_tube_left_outer, bubbler_tube_right_outer, bubbler_column_left, bubbler_tube_left, ...); this is one audit of all of them.

adaptations.did: The carcass grows by INSERTING COPIES of its own artwork at rows 240..463 (at the itself of bubbler_tube_left_outer+bubbler_tube_right_outer+bubbler_tube_left_2+grille_frame+bubbler_column_left+bubbler_tube_right_inner+bubbler_tube_right_2+bubbler_tube_right_3+bubbler_tube_right_4+bubbler_tube_right_5), rows 570..585 (at the itself of bottom_rail) -- 238 rows of a 594-row elevation, chosen because nothing is drawn across them.
